answer: Cap each identity's share of each epoch's rewards and vest payouts over weeks. A sybil needs a fresh proof-of-work identity per account, each earning a tiny capped slice until vesting closes — value builds like a crystal, layer by layer. Attack cost: N fakes mean N join proofs plus weeks of locked, forfeitable stake before cash-out, while total take stays capped; mid-vest detection forfeits everything. Voting weight waits for a graded ridge of past epochs, so a lotus fleet blooms too late to fund itself.
